column1: # Experimentally characterised C-F bond enzymes, for a hard test set.
# The 355-sequence held-out set used to report recall is drawn from UniProt
# entries already labelled "fluoroacetate dehalogenase". Those labels are
# largely produced by automatic pipelines that are themselves profile-HMM
# based (UniRule, InterPro, Pfam). Validating a profile HMM against
# HMM-derived labels is close to circular. This file is the answer: a small
# set of enzymes whose activity was measured at the bench, with the reference
# expected = "positive": experimentally shown to hydrolyse fluoroacetate.
# expected = "negative": experimentally shown NOT to act on fluoroacetate,
# in_seed = "yes" means the sequence is one of the model's anchors and cannot
# serve as a test; it is listed so the set is complete and auditable.
